handoff_descriptions.description: A large, detailed toad sits prominently on a dark, wet rock in the foreground, its bumpy green and brown skin illuminated by soft light. Behind the amphibian, turbulent ocean waves crash against the shore under a moody, deep blue sky. In the distance to the right, a lighthouse emits a warm, yellow glow that contrasts sharply with the cool, stormy tones of the sea.

This watercolor-style illustration depicts a green frog resting on a large lily pad in the center of a calm, rippling body of water. Two pink lotus buds are visible to the left, set against a backdrop of a serene sunset sky with clouds painted in shades of purple, blue, and warm orange. A small white diamond logo is situated in the bottom right corner.
